summary: The note describes the Volkswagen Polo Mk2, the second generation of the Volkswagen Polo supermini. It was produced from late 1981 until 1994 and received a major facelift in 1990. The model came in three body styles, including a distinctive kammback-styled hatchback, and its sedan version was named Volkswagen Derby.
one_line: Second-generation Volkswagen Polo supermini, produced 1981–1994, with a 1990 facelift and a sedan sold as the Derby.
key_facts: The Volkswagen Polo Mk2 is the second generation of the Volkswagen Polo supermini.
The Volkswagen Polo Mk2 was produced from late 1981 until 1994.
The Volkswagen Polo Mk2 received a major facelift in 1990.
The Volkswagen Polo Mk2 was available in three different body styles.
The Volkswagen Polo Mk2 included a distinctive kammback-styled hatchback.
The sedan version of the Volkswagen Polo Mk2 received the name Volkswagen Derby.
